section.title: Acquisitions
section.para: Collibra has used acquisitions to broaden its platform beyond catalog and governance workflows. Reported acquisitions have centered on data lineage, data quality, analytics workflows, data access, and unstructured data governance.

row.entry: Described by TechTarget in later coverage as an earlier acquisition that added lineage and metadata capabilities.
Reported as a predictive data-quality acquisition.
Reported as a data notebook acquisition for analytics tools.
Reported as a data access startup acquisition.
Reported as an acquisition aimed at unstructured data.
